tax.text: She supported the Working Families Tax Cuts Act and said it lowers taxes so people keep more of what they earn.
tax.quote: By lowering taxes, we are helping Americans keep more of what they earn and invest in their futures.

wages.text: She introduced legislation to prevent federal contracting preferences for unionized workers.
wages.quote: The government should not favor one individual over another simply because their workers are part of a union.

debt.text: She voted for 2024 appropriations legislation and supported its reductions in non-defense spending.
debt.quote: This package provides targeted cuts to wasteful non-defense programs. Importantly, it strategically reduces spending in a responsible and sustainable manner.

safety.text: She opposed defunding police and called for law enforcement to receive the tools it needs.
safety.quote: Now more than ever we must provide law enforcement with the tools they need to ensure peace and safety in our communities.

immigration.text: Her campaign says she supports stronger immigration enforcement and border security.
immigration.quote: Bice supports common-sense immigration reforms and stronger enforcement to protect national security and uphold the rule of law.

guns.text: She says she opposes congressional efforts that would limit Second Amendment rights.
guns.quote: I will oppose radical efforts in Congress that would limit this important right.

abortion.text: She praised the reversal of Roe v. Wade and said she would continue to fight for unborn babies.
abortion.quote: In Congress, I will continue to fight for unborn babies and advocate for policies that support moms who wish to give their child the gift of life through adoption.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: She voted yes on passage of the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

energy.text: She supports Oklahoma’s oil and gas industry and opposes regulations she says threaten domestic energy production and jobs.
energy.quote: She supports Oklahoma’s oil and gas industry which is responsible for producing over 10,000 barrels of oil per day and reduces our reliance on hostile foreign nations.

voting.text: She supported legislation requiring proof of citizenship to register and photo ID to vote in federal elections.
voting.quote: This legislation strengthens election safeguards by requiring proof of citizenship when registering to vote and a valid photo ID when casting a ballot in federal elections.

tax.text: She calls for windfall-profit taxes and expanded food and family assistance.
tax.quote: We need to crack down on corporate greed with stronger antitrust enforcement, windfall profit taxes and penalties for food and fuel price manipulation.

wages.text: She proposes raising the minimum wage to $17 per hour.
wages.quote: Raise the minimum wage to $17/hour, expand the Child Tax Credit and slash healthcare costs by letting Medicare negotiate drug prices.

trade.text: She cited Trump’s tariff increases as a source of economic harm.
trade.quote: We’re suffering with uninterrupted inflation, Trump Tariff increases, skyrocketing gas prices due to Trump’s Iran War and healthcare cost increases.

debt.text: She says Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid should be protected and strengthened.
debt.quote: These programs are lifelines for vulnerable Americans—we must protect and strengthen them. These programs keep families afloat—we can’t afford to lose them.

housing.text: She supports building more housing for working families.
housing.quote: Support building more new housing for Oklahoma working families, ban junk fees and provide tax credits for first-time homebuyers.

health.text: She says she would protect and strengthen Medicare and Medicaid and invest in preventive care.
health.quote: These programs are lifelines for vulnerable Americans—we must protect and strengthen them. These programs keep families afloat—we can’t afford to lose them.
